name: Onboarding design changes
description: ## Summary: Follow-up on main after ROW-77 (#171), ROW-78 (#166), ROW-80 (#165), ROW-84 and ROW-87. Make Data Root onboarding (src/tui/screens/onboarding/RootOnboarding.tsx, onboardingSteps.ts) one flow of six steps: Usage, Board (skipped when the Data Root has exactly one Board), Plugins, Agent skills, Stage Prompts (Software Factory and Both only), Summary. Remove the AI usage question and merge Factory setup into the Stage Prompts step, which offers default prompts, minimal prompts or Stage Prompt editing. Decisions confirmed by the user in Comment NnYTfwvc. ## Keep unchanged from ROW-77 (ADR-0057): step tabs that open any step when clicked, the Back, Next and Skip onboarding Buttons (ctrl+←/→, ctrl+k), Next never requiring a step to be done and finishing on the last step, completion marks on tabs, completed step ids saved in onboardingSteps in rowbly.config.json with unknown ids ignored and kept, first incomplete step opened on reopen, results shown inline in the step, no Modals. Settings is unchanged apart from the existing full-screen onboarding route (ROW-84). No forward-only tabs and no deferring writes to Finish. ## Current behavior on main: ONBOARDING_STEPS are mode (Mode), board, plugins, ai (AI and skills), factory-setup, stage-prompts, finish; visibleSteps hides plugins in Software Factory mode and the two factory steps in Plain Kanban. The Board step always asks Choose a Board for this introduction, even with one Board. The ai step asks Will you use AI agents with this Data Root? before SkillInstall. factory-setup runs software-factory setup as soon as it opens (FactorySetupScreen with params run, result, onSetUp through OnboardingPluginStep); stage-prompts draws the Stage Prompts screen inline. finish only explains completion and offers Finish onboarding. ## Steps (id, then tab label): (1) mode, Usage: How will you use this Data Root? with Plain Kanban, Software Factory, Both, as today. (2) board, Board: with several Boards the existing list; with none the existing create form; with exactly one Board the tab is not shown, onboarding puts that Board in context (services.context.use) without asking and marks board done, and a later Board added or removed recomputes this. (3) plugins, Plugins: the existing multi-select, shown in every mode (Software Factory mode no longer hides it). (4) skills, Agent skills: SkillInstall directly, with its installed markers, no AI question; marked done when a skill is installed or the person continues; Continue without installing more skills goes to the next step. Remove the ai step, its Yes/No list and the skills state. (5) stage-prompts, Stage Prompts: shown when Software Factory is on; replaces factory-setup. (6) finish, Summary: see below. A saved ai id counts as skills done and a saved factory-setup id counts as stage-prompts done, so existing progress is not lost; the old ids stay in the saved list. ## Stage Prompts step: Heading Stage Prompts. Introduction: a Stage Prompt tells an agent what to do with a Story when it enters a Stage; a supervising agent (the rowbly-factory skill) starts a worker for each Story that arrives in a Stage whose Stage Prompt is on; populating gives the Board in context the factory Stages TODO, In Progress and In Review it lacks and never renames, moves or replaces existing Stages, Stage Prompts or files (ADR-0053 §2); you can edit Stage Prompts at any time here or in Settings › Stage Prompts. No Choose agent skills option. Three options: (a) Populate Stage Prompts with default prompts: pre-built instructions written by the Rowbly team (ADR-0053 defaults, In Progress and In Review on, TODO off). (b) Populate Stage Prompts with minimal prompts: minimal placeholders you should edit later; the same factory Stages, each missing Stage Prompt written with the existing placeholder text (templateText in src/plugins/software-factory/stagePrompts.ts) and turned off. (c) Edit Stage Prompts: the inline Stage Prompts screen from ROW-78 (OnboardingPluginStep with onBack), esc returns to the three options. (a) and (b) run setup when chosen (not on step open) and show its added, kept and skipped list inline below the options, kept across Plugin reloads as today; the step is marked done after a successful run or when Next leaves it. Running the other option afterwards keeps the Stage Prompts already written, and its result says so (kept). A CONFLICT or other error shows as a toast and leaves the options available to retry. ## Summary step: Heading Summary. Lists the choices of this visit: usage mode (or Software Factory on/off when reopened), Board in context, Plugins on, skills installed in this visit with their folders, and the Stage Prompts outcome (default, minimal, edited or not set up; not shown in Plain Kanban); a step not visited reads not changed in this visit. Keep the existing completion explanation and the Finish onboarding item, which calls onDone as today. ## Software Factory setup input: Add prompts to software-factory.setup, 'default' or 'minimal', default 'default' (src/plugins/software-factory/setup.ts setupFactory and defaultPrompts.ts); minimal writes templateText for each missing factory Stage Prompt with enabled false; every other ADR-0053 §2 rule is unchanged. CLI: rowbly software-factory setup [--board <id>] [--prompts default|minimal], rejecting other values with a usage error. FactorySetupScreen takes a prompts param and no longer auto-runs from onboarding (keep params.run for other callers or remove it if onboarding was the only one). ## Docs: New ADR in docs/agents/adr/ (next free number) amending ADR-0057 §1-2 (step list and ids, ai and factory-setup aliases), ADR-0041 §2 (single-Board skip, no AI question) and ADR-0053 §2 items 3-4 (minimal prompts written off; onboarding offers default or minimal in its Stage Prompts step); update their Status lines and docs/agents/adr/README.md. Update docs/user-guide.md Onboarding section and the setup command; docs/architecture/operations.md software-factory.setup row input to { board, prompts? } (keep the table format for test/plugins/operationInventory.test.ts); docs/architecture/data-model.md onboardingSteps ids; docs/plugins/built-in.md Software Factory setup lines (about 495 and 517); skills/rowbly/references/tui.md, setup.md and plugin-software-factory.md; skills/rowbly-reference.md setup line (about 283) and its three byte-identical copies in skills/rowbly-dev, skills/rowbly-grill and skills/rowbly-factory references. ## Acceptance: (1) A Data Root with one Board shows tabs Usage, Plugins, Agent skills, Stage Prompts, Summary in Software Factory or Both, and Usage, Plugins, Agent skills, Summary in Plain Kanban, with that Board in context; with several Boards the Board tab shows after Usage. (2) The AI usage question never appears. (3) Default prompts adds the factory Stages and ADR-0053 defaults; minimal adds the Stages and placeholder Stage Prompts turned off; Edit Stage Prompts opens the inline editor; existing Stages, Stage Prompts and files are kept in every case; the result shows inline. (4) rowbly software-factory setup --prompts minimal --json does the same as (3) minimal; omitting --prompts behaves as today. (5) Summary lists the choices and Finish onboarding saves completion; tabs, Back, Next, Skip, marks and saved progress behave as ROW-77, and a Data Root with saved ai or factory-setup ids shows those steps done. (6) pnpm typecheck, lint, test:unit and test:cli pass. ## Tests: No new TUI test (AGENTS.md); verify with pnpm dev and agentic-tui screenshots in the PR. The operation inventory test must keep passing with the changed operations.md row. ## Related: ROW-80 is superseded by removing the AI step; ROW-77, ROW-78 and ROW-84 are built on; ROW-79 installed markers are kept; ROW-87 (onboarding without header and sidebar, done) is kept.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Refinement: rewrote the description on current main as a follow-up to ROW-77, ROW-78, ROW-80 and ROW-84, using the decisions in Comment NnYTfwvc: six steps Usage, Board (skipped with exactly one Board), Plugins (all modes), Agent skills (no AI question), Stage Prompts (default, minimal or edit; result inline; Software Factory and Both only), Summary. ROW-77 tabs, Back/Next/Skip, completion marks and saved onboardingSteps are kept; saved ai and factory-setup ids count as skills and stage-prompts done. Adds a prompts input (default|minimal) to software-factory setup; minimal writes the placeholder text turned off. Needs a new ADR amending ADR-0057, ADR-0041 and ADR-0053. ROW-80 is superseded. Ready for In Progress.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: User decision: use the combined ROW-86 flow. Remove the AI usage question; combine Factory setup and Stage Prompts into one Stage Prompts step with default prompts, minimal prompts and Edit Stage Prompts options; show Plugins in all modes; tabs are Usage, Board (skip when exactly one Board), Plugins, Agent skills, Stage Prompts (Software Factory or Both), Summary. Retain ROW-77 saved onboardingSteps progress, freely clickable tabs, Back/Next/Skip controls, Next without completeness gating, completion marks and inline results. This supersedes conflicting earlier details; ROW-77, ROW-78 and ROW-80 are now merged, so ROW-86 is a follow-up on main. Minimal prompts use the existing placeholder template text and are off by default; setup accepts default|minimal prompts. Do not reintroduce forward-only tabs or apply-on-Finish behavior.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Factory coordination: ADR-0059 reserved for ROW-86 combined onboarding amendments. ROW-89 uses ADR-0058; keep existing numbers and verify main plus open branches before final publication.
